description.value: Mix the Bakery is an award-winning artisan bakery and neighbourhood café located in Vancouver's West Point Grey, operating since 2003. It produces handmade, preservative-free breads using a 100-year-old natural yeast starter alongside freshly made coffee, handcrafted sandwiches, and soups. The bakery supplies bread to several of Vancouver's top-rated restaurants and offers catering and wholesale services alongside its walk-in café.
